target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure P] (F : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0) (g : Ω → ℝ), MeasureTheory.Integrable g P → @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable Ω ℝ _ (⨆ n, F n) g → (∀ᵐ ω ∂P, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (MeasureTheory.condExp (F n) P g) ω) Filter.atTop (nhds (g ω))) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (MeasureTheory.condExp (F n) P g - g) 1 P) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
